value.request: Calculate the present element pitch as a fraction of free-space wavelength.
value.response: The present element pitch along both array principal axes (rows and columns) is 0.55 λ₀ (free-space wavelengths). At 2.45 GHz (λ₀ ≈ 122.36 mm), this corresponds to a physical element spacing of approximately 67.30 mm. Note that this value reflects the canonical array spacing and ideal periodic principal-plane geometry; it does not model mutual coupling, finite-array truncation, or full-wave electromagnetic effects.
